subject: Deployment mode & pricing follow-up — Acme.ai pilot sizing
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Cole <sarah@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode follow-up - notes + next steps

Hi Sarah - thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can size pricing properly: 

Recap:
- Primary goal: integrate LLM assistant into Acme.ai support flow (generation-heavy).
- Latency SLA: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 350ms for short/interactive prompts.
- Data: customer PII may appear in prompts; data residency preference: US-only.
- Traffic profile (rough): avg tokens per request ~600; expected steady-state ~100k requests/day (~60M tokens/day); peak concurrency ~25-35 concurrent requests.
- Preferred deployment modes: leaning toward Dedicated capacity for predictable latency, but need confirmation on Private/VPC if required by security team.

What we need from you to finalize cost models:
1) Confirm the expected average tokens/request and an example traffic CSV (timestamps + request sizes) - I attached a sample CSV you can populate (ACME_ML_traffic.csv).
2) Any hard constraints for VPC/on-prem (e.g., firewall rules, IP allowlists, KMS requirement).
3) Target pilot length & success metrics (latency, throughput, cost per 1k requests).

What we'll deliver after we get the CSV and constraints:
- 3 pricing options: Hosted (per-token estimate), Dedicated (reserved commits with sample commit sizes and expected utilization), Private/VPC (setup + infra + monthly license).
- Back-of-envelope monthly cost and a simple TCO comparison (token vs capacity economics).
- A recommended pilot configuration (duration + acceptance criteria).

Attached: ACME_ML_traffic.csv (sample) - fill and send back when convenient.

Next steps: can you confirm the CSV and whether your security team will require Private VPC? If not, we'll proceed with Dedicated + Hosted comparisons.

Thanks - talk soon.

—
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Cole <sarah@acme.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Finance Team <finance@acme.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up - notes + next steps

Thanks Aditya - good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

Traffic/details:
- Avg tokens/request: ~600 (we ran a quick sample).
- Expected volume: target launch is ~100k requests/day, ramp to ~300k/day over 3 months if pilot metrics look good (so planning guidance should include a ramp scenario).
- Peak concurrency: up to ~40 concurrent requests during business hours.

Requirements:
- Data residency: US-only preferred.
- Security: we require customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest AND an audit log for all inference requests. SOC2 attestation is helpful but not strictly required for pilot.
- Network: if we go Private, we need the service to sit in our VPC behind an internal ALB and use mutual TLS; otherwise Dedicated with IP allowlisting is acceptable.

Pilot:
- We would like a 6-8 week pilot with real traffic (subset of customers). Acceptance criteria: p95 latency within 350ms, <1% error rate, and cost per 1k requests below $X (we'll leave this flexible - please propose).

I'll attach a filled traffic export (see ACME_ML_traffic_POPULATED.csv) - sending separately. Finance is looped for later procurement questions.

Regards,
Sarah Cole
Head of AI Products
Acme.ai

On Thu, 26 Mar 2026 at 11:05 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai> wrote:
> From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
> To: Sarah Cole <sarah@acme.ai>
> Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
> Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up - preliminary cost models attached
> 
> Hi Sarah - appreciate the details and the populated CSV. I ran a quick back-of-envelope and attached a more formal sheet (redwood-dedicated-commit-calculator.xlsx) with three scenarios: Hosted (per-token), Dedicated (reserved commit / monthly capacity), and Private VPC (setup + infra + monthly license). Highlights below:
> 
> High-level estimates (monthly, indicative):
> - Hosted (per-token): assuming 60M tokens/day steady-state, estimated ~1.8B tokens/month -> ballpark cost $1,440k/month (at $0.0008/token list-rate). This is the simplest to start but becomes expensive at scale.
> - Dedicated (reserved commit): for your peak concurrency/latency profile we project a 3x NVIDIA A100-equivalent pool (multi-GPU cluster) with reserved commit approx $220k/month (after commit discount) -> effective per-token cost drops significantly with >70% utilization.
> - Private VPC/on-prem: one-time onboarding + infra: ~$30k one-time setup + ongoing infra + license ~$240k/month (varies with customer-supplied infra). This gives the most control (KMS, VPC), but higher fixed costs.
> 
> Notes & assumptions:
> - Token rates are list-level for Hosted; committed Dedicated pricing includes a 30-50% discount depending on term.
> - All estimates exclude occasional failing request retries and network egress for private deployments.
> - We modeled a ramp (0 -> 100k -> 300k/day) in the attached sheet; see sheet tab "ramp-scenarios".
> 
> Next steps I propose:
> 1) Marissa can run a short sizing call with your infra/ops (30-45m) to validate concurrency and latency targets, and confirm KMS/network constraints.
> 2) If Dedicated looks good, we can draft a 6-8 week Pilot SOW (minimal commit) and a contract addendum for Private if you choose that path.
> 3) Finance: we can provide a preliminary proforma for the pilot and an estimated committed rate if you sign for 6/12/24 month terms.
> 
> Attached: redwood-dedicated-commit-calculator.xlsx
> 
> Thanks - happy to hop on a sizing call this week.
> 
> —
> Aditya Rao
> Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
> aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Cole <sarah@acme.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up - sizing call + pilot plan

Thanks all - quick technical follow-up from our side so we can size the pilot properly: 

1) Can you share a 48-72h sample of live request traces (timestamps + token counts + response size) - the populated CSV Sarah mentioned works great. We'll use that to simulate prefix reuse and batching benefits.
2) For Dedicated sizing: we assume 3x A100-equivalent GPUs based on current numbers, but if typical prompts are shorter than 600 tokens we may be able to move to a 2x configuration.
3) For Private/VPC: please confirm whether Acme will provide the VPC (preferred) or you'd want Redwood to deploy into a customer-managed VPC. Also confirm KMS provider (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / customer HSM).

Pilot proposal (draft):
- Duration: 6 weeks (4 weeks live pilot + 2 weeks ramp/down).
- Scope: subset of traffic (10-25% of production), production monitoring (latency, error rates, token counts), cost reporting and weekly checkpoints.
- Acceptance: p95 latency < 350ms and error rate < 1% for the pilot traffic slice.

If you confirm the CSV and KMS/VPC option, I can draft a short SOW and a simple pilot pricing addendum (minimal commit) - attached a sample SOW template (redwood-pilot-sow-draft.docx).

Proposed next immediate step: 30m sizing call early next week (I can do Mon/Tue mornings). Please suggest times.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Cole <sarah@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@acme.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up - confirming pilot interest

Thanks Marissa/Aditya - we want to move forward with a 6-week Dedicated pilot (minimal commit) first. Key asks for the pilot contract/SOW:

- Please include a short clause for Private/VPC option evaluation (we may convert to Private after pilot).
- Pilot pricing: please propose a monthly pilot rate and a discount tier if we convert to a 12-month committed Dedicated contract.
- Timeline: kickoff next week (week of Mar 30) with the sizing call; pilot to start Apr 6 if the SOW is approved.

Finance: please send a draft PO/proforma to finance@acme.ai once Redwood confirms pilot pricing.

Sarah Cole
Head of AI Products, Acme.ai
